questions.question: What does project scope refer to?
options: Only the project’s budget
All the work involved in creating products or services and the processes to create them
Only the project’s schedule
The number of project team members
questions.answer: All the work involved in creating products or services and the processes to create them

questions.question: What are the two main outputs of planning scope management?
options: Project charter and project schedule
WBS and accepted deliverables
Scope management plan and requirements management plan
Cost baseline and risk register
questions.answer: Scope management plan and requirements management plan

questions.question: Which technique collects requirements by watching users perform their work?
options: Observation
Benchmarking
Brainstorming
Prototyping

questions.question: What is a task at the lowest level of the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) called?
options: Project phase
Scope statement
Milestone
Work package

questions.question: Which project management process involves the formal acceptance of completed project deliverables?
options: Defining scope
Controlling scope
Validating scope
Collecting requirements

questions.question: Which of the following correctly lists all six processes of project scope management?
options: Plan scope management, collect requirements, define scope, create the WBS, validate scope, and control scope
Initiate project, plan scope, define scope, execute scope, validate scope, close scope
Plan scope, collect requirements, build schedule, estimate costs, validate scope, control scope
Collect requirements, define scope, create WBS, build prototypes, test deliverables, control scope
questions.answer: Plan scope management, collect requirements, define scope, create the WBS, validate scope, and control scope

questions.question: Collecting requirements and defining scope are two of the six official processes of project scope management.
At a minimum, what should a project scope statement include?
options: The project manager's resume, the project sponsor's contact info, and team salaries
A product scope description, product user acceptance criteria, and detailed information about all project deliverables
Only the boundaries and constraints of what is excluded from the project
The Work Breakdown Structure and the project schedule
questions.answer: A product scope description, product user acceptance criteria, and detailed information about all project deliverables

questions.question: A project scope statement only needs to include the project schedule and cost baseline.
Why is the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) considered a critical tool in project management?
options: It serves as the formal contract between the vendor and the client.
It lists all the stakeholders and their current engagement levels.
It divides major deliverables into manageable components, defines the total project scope, and supports planning schedules and costs.
It tracks the daily attendance and performance of the project team members.
questions.answer: It divides major deliverables into manageable components, defines the total project scope, and supports planning schedules and costs.

questions.question: In the context of scope control, what is the primary purpose of variance analysis?
options: To brainstorm new features to add to the project scope.
To compare planned performance against actual performance to identify differences and support decisions about controlling scope.
To write the code for automated testing software.
To officially sign off and accept the final deliverables from the project team.
questions.answer: To compare planned performance against actual performance to identify differences and support decisions about controlling scope.

questions.question: Which of the following is considered a best practice for avoiding scope problems in a project?
options: Avoid involving users until the final testing phase.
Accept all scope changes without adjusting time or budget to please the client.
Keep the scope realistic, involve users in scope management, and follow good project management processes.
Build all technology from scratch instead of using Commercial-Off-The-Shelf (COTS) software.
questions.answer: Keep the scope realistic, involve users in scope management, and follow good project management processes.

questions.question: Involving users actively in scope management and keeping project goals realistic are proven ways to avoid scope problems.
